judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Breathless exclamation-heavy pleas, the comma-splice run-ons ('north of here and kidnapped'), the 'Hail, brave Adventurer!' address and the cheeky 'menfolk cannot live without us' gag all read like Nox's side-quest NPCs; the plain one-line journal fits too. Only slight doubt is how neatly the escort beats are covered.
